TRUE transparent background. No text, labels, lines, floor, shadows, bolts, extra parts. Product catalog AI illustration.

modelPrompts.gst: This is a benign electrical earthing connector for building wiring. Solid vertical copper earth rod extends BOTH above and below the central joint; one continuous stranded copper wire crosses horizontally in front.
